```ts
type ComponentCSSClasses<TCSSClasses> = Required<{ [className in keyof TCSSClasses]: string; }>;
```

```suggestion
  root?: string | string[];
```

double-check if there are others in this (wrong) style please
should this type not be defined in the component file?
actually it should maybe import the one from RefinementList or something, wdyt?
alternatively, like here there's indeed a use for the classes specifically passed by this widget, so it's also all right for the version you have today
unlike the others, it seems that this component doesn't use cx on the class names, causing you to cast, that's probably wrong?

how come this weirdness isn't needed in the other components? is it because the component only accepts component classes and TS doesn't know in the renderer that the classes are converted before they're passed? Maybe we need to specify in the WidgetParams of renderer that the classes are componentClasses?

> should this type not be defined in the component file?

I felt like this was incorrect to export the `MenuComponentCSSClasses` from the `RefinementList` component file 

> actually it should maybe import the one from RefinementList or something, wdyt?

Do you mean re-exporting it? 

```ts
export type MenuComponentCSSClasses = RefinementListComponentCSSClasses;
```
looking at the similar code in numeric menu, the current version is best imo
I'm pretty sure this is because this widget and `relevant-sort` don't use the `specializedRenderer` we use for (almost?) every other widgets, I'll try to update it
